CLOUD REVIEWER seat for PR #2559 of tvofi/heatpump_optimizer, at head 802b38503eb5de20e87c278ba7923508a50c0f1f. Bus nonce: 3b1255fa5a49d4c6524da1bfde40756b. Never send push notifications.
Setup: `git fetch --unshallow --tags origin`. The toolchain (venv python, node, gh) is on PATH from the environment. Run anything heavy in the background with Monitor and no timeout.
Role: read dev/governance/roles/fix-review.md and its rules from main, and follow them exactly. Fetch the PR head with `git fetch origin 802b38503eb5de20e87c278ba7923508a50c0f1f`; the PR body is in the PR. Verify each claim adversarially: mutate the fix and check the tests fail, and check every figure in the body at this head. Check that it merges with origin/main (`git merge-tree --write-tree`) and read CI on this head from the check-runs API.
Output: in a fresh directory of your own (`W=$(mktemp -d)`), write verdict.md, whose first line is exactly `Fix review: merge 802b38503eb5de20e87c278ba7923508a50c0f1f` or `Fix review: blocked 802b38503eb5de20e87c278ba7923508a50c0f1f <class>: <reason>` (no brackets; the class is lower-case letters and dashes), in the format the role file gives, then a blank line, then `bus-nonce: 3b1255fa5a49d4c6524da1bfde40756b`; put the evidence in `ev/` beside it, and make at least one file under `ev/` contain the full 40-hex head `802b38503eb5de20e87c278ba7923508a50c0f1f` (e.g. `ev/HEAD.txt` holding the head you reviewed, beside your command output): bus.sh refuses a verdict whose `ev/` names no head. Do NOT run bus.sh: its dispatch record lives on the orchestrator's machine, which publishes the verdict there (cloud_relay.sh). Return the verdict on a probe ref, and push nothing else; this builds one parentless commit with a private index and touches no branch of your checkout: `R=$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel); G=$(git rev-parse --absolute-git-dir); mkdir -p $W/pr && cp -r $W/verdict.md $W/ev $W/pr/ && cd $W/pr && T=$(GIT_DIR=$G GIT_INDEX_FILE=$W/idx GIT_WORK_TREE=$W/pr sh -c 'git add -A -f . && git write-tree') && C=$(GIT_DIR=$G git -c user.name=seat -c user.email=seat@users.noreply.github.com commit-tree $T -m "verdict 2559 802b38503eb5de20e87c278ba7923508a50c0f1f") && git -C $R push -q origin $C:refs/heads/probe/rev-2559-3b1255fa`. That ref is the return signal. Do not post comments, approve or merge.
Never write to any branch except your return refs. Never work around a hook or a refusal; report it in your result instead.

Brief (snapshotted when this payload was rendered):
Fix reviewer for PR #2559, group none (roster PR, topic audit-r10-roster; no group entry matched; review against the PR body and say so). Round 5: the head keeps moving under review because every roster edit or main merge is auto-merged into the PR branch. The roster is now frozen: review THIS head and nothing newer. The roster diff against origin/main covers: R10-CI-LAYOUT-P1/-P2 carries, R10-OPENPR-SILENT stage, the R10-BRIEFS-FOLD append-carry (617ce131: D2 step-5 gains-arm precondition, converged heat-loss level, genuine gain, control gains.converged.rel_dev > 0.05 with gains.unconverged.rel_dev 0.0000), and R10-MERGE-PR-MANDATE set to done (2c76c312). Use the finder harness the PR body names (jq over the roster JSON at origin/main vs the head), never the fixer harness. Follow dev/governance/roles/fix-review.md exactly, from a detached worktree at the head; if the live PR head differs from yours when you finish, say so in the verdict but still judge the head named in your assignment. A red nightly-status grades main and is not this PR. Your ev/ MUST contain a file holding the full 40-hex head sha (ev/HEAD.txt).
